Your Porto weekend note now has a trip page. I haven't opened it in the app, so I haven't seen how it looks.

- **Countdown:** a days-to-go counter based on your outbound flight on 16 Oct.
- **Flights and hotel:** both flights, plus Casa do Conto with the address, confirmation number and check-in time. Your ~6000 kr budget is shown too.
- **Ideas:** a list you can tick off by tapping.
- **To-dos:** book Lello tickets, buy travel insurance (already ticked) and download offline maps.

I added `[ ]` checkboxes to your five idea lines in the note so they can be ticked. Nothing else in the text changed. The page reads from the note, so any edits you make there show up on the page.
